script:
control-agent-server api POST <redacted:session-cookie>/00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000000/switch_llm \
  --json '{"llm": {"model": "openai/qa-f09-x", "usage_id": "qa-f09-x"}}' --expect 404 --save F09.switch-llm-errors/unknown-conversation
control-agent-server api POST "<redacted:session-cookie>/$CID/switch_llm" --json '{}' --expect 422 --check detail.0.loc.1 eq llm --save F09.switch-llm-errors/no-llm
control-agent-server api POST "<redacted:session-cookie>/$CID/switch_llm" --json '{"llm": {"api_key": "sk-qa-f09", "usage_id": "qa-f09-nomodel"}}' \
  --expect 422 --check detail.0.msg contains 'model must be specified'
control-agent-server api POST "<redacted:session-cookie>/$CID/switch_llm" \
  --json '{"llm": {"model": "openai/qa-f09-dangling", "provider_connection_id": "qa-f09-missing", "usage_id": "qa-f09-dangling"}}' \
  --expect 422 --check detail contains "provider connection 'qa-f09-missing', which does not exist" --save F09.switch-llm-errors/dangling-connection
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$CID" --quiet --check agent.llm.model eq openai/qa-f09-ws --check agent.llm.usage_id eq qa-f09-ws
